data.title: Israel reportedly plans strike on Iran as regime rebuilds nuclear program | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: "We will move to strike nuclear facilities and any site belonging to them again if Tehran crosses any of the red lines, whether with or without the participation of the US," an Israeli official said.
